description: Fresh random sample from entire course - independent verification round

scoring_criteria.mutation_accuracy: Soft mutations after i, yn, newydd, feminine articles, etc.
scoring_criteria.dialect_consistency: South Welsh: moyn, gyda, nawr, mas, dishgled, joio, 'di, so, etc.
scoring_criteria.natural_spoken: Natural spoken Welsh vs literary/textbook forms

worst_3_phrases.english: I met an old man who wanted
worst_3_phrases.other: wnes i gwrdd â hen ddyn oedd yn moyn
worst_3_phrases.reason: Incomplete sentence - 'who wanted' lacks an object. Pedagogically awkward to teach an incomplete clause. Mutations are correct (ddyn after hen).

worst_3_phrases.english: if you knew how high she was throwing it
worst_3_phrases.other: 'set ti'n gwybod faint mor uchel oedd hi'n ei dwlid e
worst_3_phrases.reason: 'dwlid' is a non-standard/unusual form. Standard would be 'taflu' or colloquial 'towlu/twlu'. The conditional form ('set) is good South Welsh.

worst_3_phrases.english: I'm going to practice speaking for about a week
worst_3_phrases.other: dw i'n mynd i ymarfer siarad am biti wythnos
worst_3_phrases.reason: 'am biti wythnos' is an unusual colloquial form. More commonly 'am tua wythnos' or 'am ryw wythnos'. Still valid but non-standard.

systematic_issues: None significant - dialect consistency is excellent throughout
All phrases correctly use South Welsh forms (moyn, gyda, mas, 'di, so, joio, dishgled)
Mutation accuracy is very high - soft mutations correctly applied in nearly all cases
One incomplete phrase (idx 47) suggests possible generation artifact
strengths: Natural spoken Welsh rather than literary/textbook forms
High pedagogical value - authentic spoken patterns

phrases.english: where do you want to start?
phrases.other: ble wyt ti'n moyn dechrau?
phrases.notes: Good South Welsh (moyn), correct mutations, natural.

phrases.english: you didn't tell me what I wanted to know
phrases.other: ddwedest ti ddim wrtha i beth o'n i'n moyn gwybod
phrases.notes: Good soft mutation on ddwedest, South Welsh forms, natural spoken style.

phrases.english: I said that he doesn't want to go until we finish
phrases.other: ddwedes i fod e ddim yn moyn mynd nes i ni gwpla
phrases.notes: Good South Welsh (gwpla), colloquial 'nes i ni' construction acceptable.

phrases.english: I've just started to say something
phrases.other: dw i newydd ddechrau dweud rhywbeth
phrases.notes: Correct soft mutation after newydd (ddechrau). Natural.

phrases.english: I'm going to learn more if I can
phrases.other: dw i'n mynd i ddysgu mwy os galla i
phrases.notes: Correct soft mutation (ddysgu), natural construction.

phrases.english: on the other side of the bridge
phrases.other: ar ochr arall y bont
phrases.notes: Correct soft mutation (bont after feminine definite article), natural.

phrases.english: do you want something to drink?
phrases.other: ŷch chi'n moyn rhywbeth i yfed?
phrases.notes: Good South Welsh (ŷch chi, moyn). Natural.

phrases.english: nobody wants to eat that
phrases.other: does neb yn moyn bwyta hynny
phrases.notes: Correct negative construction, South Welsh moyn.

phrases.english: I'm going to learn how to speak Welsh
phrases.other: dw i'n mynd i ddysgu sut i siarad Cymraeg
phrases.notes: Correct mutations, natural.

phrases.english: I still need to say something in Welsh
phrases.other: dw i dal angen dweud rhywbeth yn Gymraeg
phrases.notes: Correct soft mutation (Gymraeg after yn), natural South Welsh (dal).

phrases.english: I saw a lot of friends
phrases.other: weles i lawer o ffrindiau
phrases.notes: Good South Welsh (weles), correct soft mutation (lawer).

phrases.english: the boy wants to go out tonight
phrases.other: mae'r bachgen yn moyn mynd mas heno
phrases.notes: South Welsh (moyn, mas). Natural.

phrases.english: the old man is trying to remember something
phrases.other: mae'r hen ddyn yn trio cofio rhywbeth
phrases.notes: Correct soft mutation (ddyn after hen), South Welsh trio.

phrases.english: I didn't do what he wanted
phrases.other: wnes i ddim gwneud beth oedd e'n moyn
phrases.notes: Correct but slightly redundant construction. Acceptable.

phrases.english: I want to know what was happening
phrases.other: dw i'n moyn gwybod be' oedd yn digwydd
phrases.notes: Good South Welsh (moyn, be'), natural.

phrases.english: it is wrong to say that he wouldn't make mistakes
phrases.other: mae'n anghywir dweud na fyddai fe'n gwneud camgymeriadau
phrases.notes: Complex construction, correct. Slightly literary but pedagogically valuable.

phrases.english: I'd better speak Welsh with you
phrases.other: well i fi siarad Cymraeg gyda ti
phrases.notes: Good South Welsh (gyda), natural idiom.

phrases.english: I'm having the same problem myself
phrases.other: dw i'n cael yr un broblem fy hunan
phrases.notes: Correct soft mutation (broblem after feminine un), South Welsh (fy hunan).

phrases.english: you speak Welsh very well
phrases.other: ti'n siarad Cymraeg yn dda iawn
phrases.notes: Natural, colloquial South Welsh.

phrases.english: to go out sometime
phrases.other: mynd mas rhywbryd
phrases.notes: Good South Welsh (mas), but infinitive phrase is somewhat bare for pedagogical purposes.

phrases.english: I'm going to change it for next time
phrases.other: dw i'n mynd i'w newid e ar gyfer tro nesa
phrases.notes: Correct infixed pronoun construction (i'w newid e). Natural.

phrases.english: I'm going to practice speaking for about a week
phrases.other: dw i'n mynd i ymarfer siarad am biti wythnos
phrases.notes: 'am biti wythnos' is colloquial but unusual - more commonly 'am tua wythnos'. Still valid dialectal.

phrases.english: we'd like to tell them something else
phrases.other: hoffen ni ddweud rhywbeth arall wrthyn nhw
phrases.notes: Correct soft mutation (ddweud), natural.

phrases.english: I want a cup of tea
phrases.other: dw i'n moyn dishgled o de
phrases.notes: Very South Welsh (dishgled for 'cup' - regional variant). Correct soft mutation (de).

phrases.english: would you put your hands together?
phrases.other: wnewch chi roi eich dwylo gyda'i gilydd?
phrases.notes: Correct mutation (roi). Slightly formal but acceptable.

phrases.english: so we don't see them very often
phrases.other: felly so ni'n gweld nhw yn aml iawn
phrases.notes: Very South Welsh (so ni'n for 'we're not/we don't'). Authentic spoken dialect.

phrases.english: I still need to try to improve
phrases.other: dw i dal angen trio gwella
phrases.notes: Good South Welsh (dal, trio). Natural.

phrases.english: I enjoy speaking with you
phrases.other: dw i'n joio siarad gyda ti
phrases.notes: South Welsh (joio, gyda). Natural spoken Welsh.

phrases.english: did you say that you wanted milk with your coffee?
phrases.other: ddwedoch chi bo' chi'n moyn llaeth gyda'ch coffi?
phrases.notes: Correct mutations, South Welsh (bo', moyn, gyda). Natural.

phrases.english: my father wants to go out next Saturday
phrases.other: mae fy nhad yn moyn mynd mas ddydd Sadwrn nesa'
phrases.notes: Correct nasal mutation (nhad after fy), South Welsh (moyn, mas).

phrases.english: I want to say what I think
phrases.other: dw i'n moyn dweud beth dw i'n meddwl
phrases.notes: Natural, South Welsh moyn.

phrases.english: when are you starting to learn?
phrases.other: pryd wyt ti'n dechrau dysgu?
phrases.notes: Natural, correct.

phrases.english: you said that you wanted to wait for them
phrases.other: ddwedest ti bo' ti'n moyn aros amdanyn nhw
phrases.notes: Correct mutations, South Welsh (bo', moyn).

phrases.english: you've already done very well
phrases.other: ti 'di gwneud yn dda iawn yn barod
phrases.notes: Very natural South Welsh ('di for wedi).

phrases.english: if you knew how high she was throwing it
phrases.other: 'set ti'n gwybod faint mor uchel oedd hi'n ei dwlid e
phrases.notes: 'dwlid' is non-standard/unusual. Standard would be 'taflu' or colloquial 'towlu/twlu'. South Welsh conditional ('set) is good.

phrases.english: do you want to talk about that film tonight?
phrases.other: wyt ti'n moyn siarad am y ffilm 'na heno?
phrases.notes: Correct, natural, South Welsh.

phrases.english: part of the problem is that we don't know the facts
phrases.other: rhan o'r broblem yw nag ŷn ni'n gwybod y ffeithiau
phrases.notes: 'nag ŷn ni'n' is South Welsh negative. Correct soft mutation (broblem). Slightly formal but accurate.

phrases.english: the boy there is fifteen
phrases.other: mae'r bachgen yna'n bymtheg
phrases.notes: Correct soft mutation (bymtheg after yn). Natural.

phrases.english: I'd rather not answer until I think about it
phrases.other: well 'da fi beidio ateb nes i fi feddwl amdani
phrases.notes: Good South Welsh ('da fi). 'amdani' implies feminine antecedent - minor contextual ambiguity.

phrases.english: would you like to go out?
phrases.other: hoffet ti fynd mas?
phrases.notes: Correct soft mutation (fynd), South Welsh (mas). Natural.

phrases.english: but they should ask for more help
phrases.other: ond dylen nhw ofyn am fwy o help
phrases.notes: Correct soft mutation (ofyn). Natural.

phrases.english: we've got a daughter in her twenties
phrases.other: mae gyda ni ferch yn ei hugeiniau
phrases.notes: South Welsh (gyda), correct soft mutation (ferch). Natural.

phrases.english: you're choosing to make mistakes
phrases.other: ti'n dewis gwneud camgymeriadau
phrases.notes: Natural, colloquial South Welsh.

phrases.english: did you have more time to learn at the weekend?
phrases.other: gest ti fwy o amser i ddysgu ar y penwythnos?
phrases.notes: Correct soft mutation (ddysgu), natural.

phrases.english: I need to go there tonight
phrases.other: dw i angen mynd yno heno
phrases.notes: Natural South Welsh construction.

phrases.english: it appears that the clothes are absolutely clean
phrases.other: mae'n ymddangos bod y dillad yn gwbl glân
phrases.notes: Correct soft mutation (glân after gwbl). Slightly literary/formal but accurate.

phrases.english: I met an old man who wanted
phrases.other: wnes i gwrdd â hen ddyn oedd yn moyn
phrases.notes: Incomplete phrase - 'who wanted' lacks an object. Pedagogically awkward. Mutations correct (ddyn after hen).

phrases.english: I said that I wanted her to help you
phrases.other: ddwedes i bo' fi'n moyn iddi hi dy helpu di
phrases.notes: Complex construction done correctly. South Welsh (bo', moyn).

phrases.english: I'm happy with a glass or two
phrases.other: dw i'n hapus gyda gwydred neu ddau
phrases.notes: Correct soft mutation (ddau after neu). South Welsh (gyda). Natural.

phrases.english: the oldest is ten, and that one is five
phrases.other: mae'r hynaf yn ddeg, ac mae honno yn bump
phrases.notes: Correct mutations (ddeg, bump after yn). 'honno' correctly implies feminine referent.
